## What's new

- **Simpler Settings.** Five short panes: General, Playback, Library, Phone remote, and About and data. Everything technical sits behind "Show advanced settings", and the TMDB key is hidden until you ask to see it.
- **Easier Add playlist.** Just a name, the portal address and the MAC. Credentials, serial, device IDs and signatures are under More options.
- **Cleaner Home.** Continue-watching tiles show one Play button and one small actions pill, keep their titles on hover, and use a single focus ring. The hero has three matching buttons on a dark scrim in both themes, and the hover backdrop now runs edge to edge.
- **More Apple-like look.** Frosted menus, a soft sidebar selection, one scale for text sizes and corners, and import and export icons that point the right way.
- **Fixes.** Recently Watched and Favorites no longer show a "hidden list" message when empty; failed category loads have a Retry button; the Guide shows channel initials with its shortcuts behind a ? button; download titles lose repeated episode codes and dates; Arc TV starts normally even if its phone-remote port is already in use.

versions.notes:
## What's new

- **Simpler Settings.** Five short panes: General, Playback, Library, Phone remote, and About and data. Everything technical sits behind "Show advanced settings", and the TMDB key is hidden until you ask to see it.
- **Easier Add playlist.** Just a name, the portal address and the MAC. Credentials, serial, device IDs and signatures are under More options.
- **Cleaner Home.** Continue-watching tiles show one Play button and one small actions pill, keep their titles on hover, and use a single focus ring. The hero has three matching buttons on a dark scrim in both themes, and the hover backdrop now runs edge to edge.
- **More Apple-like look.** Frosted menus, a soft sidebar selection, one scale for text sizes and corners, and import and export icons that point the right way.
- **Fixes.** Recently Watched and Favorites no longer show a "hidden list" message when empty; failed category loads have a Retry button; the Guide shows channel initials with its shortcuts behind a ? button; download titles lose repeated episode codes and dates; Arc TV starts normally even if its phone-remote port is already in use.

## What's new

- **Subtitles on frosted glass.** Captions sit on one slightly see-through dark panel with clean white text and no outline, and scale with the player. The subtitle colour choice is gone, so captions always read the same.
- **Phone remote: Full screen, Subtitles and Audio.** While a video plays, the phone has a Full screen button and Subtitles and Audio buttons that show the current choice and step to the next one.
- **Episode Play button** is a dark frosted disc instead of a white blob in dark mode.
- **Smarter lists and settings.** Recent searches keep only what you opened. Empty Radio says "stations". Downloads no longer calls paused items "Downloading now" or shows a "0 B" total. Live TV initials skip tags like 4K. Settings drops the stale "recording" wording, shows the phone pairing QR straight away and says "latest version" once.

## What's new

- **One player, built in.** MPV, VLC and the experimental Embedded MPV player are gone. Live TV, movies and series now play in the built-in player (HTML5, Video.js or Art Player). If you had chosen an external player, Arc TV switches you to the default built-in one automatically.
- **Subtitles the Apple TV way.** Clean white text with a soft shadow and no box behind it, in the system font.
- **Live recording is removed**, together with its settings and the record button. Files you already recorded stay on disk, untouched.
- **Smaller download.** Installers no longer bundle the libmpv/FFmpeg runtime.

Safer, calmer and roomier. Episodes have one big Play button and a ⋯ menu for Mark watched, Download and details; season downloads ask first and single downloads can be undone. Series and movie pages use the full width, the player header is cleaner, lists say Loading instead of 0 items, and Live TV channels without a logo show their initials. The phone remote shows what is selected, asks for a second OK on risky buttons, and has new Play and Episodes shortcuts.

The phone remote now works from your home screen. Add it to the home screen after pairing and the icon opens already paired, instead of asking for the QR code again. After Reset pairing, open the new QR link once and add the icon again.

Phone remote polish: the D-pad and Back are no longer stuck while a notification is showing, the first arrow press starts in the main content, the seek bar stays where you drop it, play/pause shows Buffering while the video is loading, and typed text with accents or emoji arrives intact.

The phone remote is redesigned in Arc TV's glass look and now controls the whole app. Move around and open titles with a round click-pad, play, pause and seek movies and shows (10 seconds back or forward), change volume and episodes, and search with your phone's keyboard. Scan the QR code in Settings → Remote control once to pair; old bookmarked links need a rescan.

Shows that your portal lists under Movies now open under Series from Search. Home's Live card opens your portal's Live TV, and Actor and Discover links stay on your Stalker portal. Includes 1.1.3: movies from Continue watching play.

Fix: movies opened from Continue watching on Home now play (Arc TV looks up the movie's playback details on your portal). Includes 1.1.2 and 1.1.1 fixes for series episodes, and 1.1.0: Stalker-only app, no Windows builds.

Fix: opening a show from Continue watching now loads its seasons and episodes (shows your portal lists inside its movie section). Includes 1.1.1 and 1.1.0 changes: Stalker-only app, no Windows builds.

Fixes: series that your portal lists inside its movie section now open with their seasons and episodes from the Series section, and category lists no longer show a meaningless dash pill. Also includes 1.1.0: Stalker-only app (Xtream and M3U removed) and no more Windows builds.

Arc TV for desktop now supports Stalker portals only. Xtream Codes and M3U playlists have been removed (existing sources stay in your data but are hidden), along with Windows builds. Fixes: series listed in a portal's movie section now appear under Series, and Continue watching on Home keeps every title you have started.

**Arc TV for Mac** 1.0.1 — Apple silicon (M1 and newer) and Intel.

**What's new:** Arc TV for Mac can now update itself. Open **Settings → About**, choose **Download**, then **Restart to
update**. Arc TV swaps itself for the new version and opens again, your playlists and settings are kept, and the old
version is put back automatically if anything goes wrong.

Arc TV has to be in your **Applications** folder to update itself.
